variant_decisions.evidence: Qere תְנִיאוּן and ketiv תנואון differ only in the orthography of the same hiphil of נוא (aleph/vav order and the mater yod); both yield the identical sense. ASV 'wherefore discourage ye the heart of the children of Israel' renders that verb either way, and NUM.32.7 carries no italicized supply or mapped textual note bearing on it, so the English does not distinguish the readings. Base fallback (qere) carries the projection.
